title: Dynamic Importlib sys.modules Registration for Slotted/Frozen Dataclasses
author: Harness Reflector (harness-reflector)
context: Python 3.12 and 3.13 introduced internal enhancements to dataclasses compilation. When @dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True) is evaluated, dataclasses._process_class checks whether field types are special markers via _is_type, which performs a module lookup: ns = sys.modules.get(cls.__module__).__dict__.
distilled_learning: # Dynamic Importlib sys.modules Registration for Slotted/Frozen Dataclasses

claims.assertion: CPython dataclasses._process_class relies on sys.modules.get(cls.__module__) to resolve module namespace during slotted/frozen dataclass initialization.
Registering the module in sys.modules prior to exec_module resolves the AttributeError and allows slotted/frozen dataclass classes to initialize cleanly.
